## 2024-05-29 - Accessibility Fallbacks for Form Elements
**Learning:** React form inputs (Input, Textarea, Select) often lack explicit IDs when used by developers, breaking `<label htmlFor>` and `aria-describedby` links. Utilizing React 18 `useId()` creates a robust fallback mechanism that ensures these critical accessibility associations are never broken.
**Action:** Always wrap form components with a default `id` generated by `useId()` if `props.id` is undefined. Ensure `aria-describedby` uses valid ID lists (filtering out undefined elements) rather than passing empty strings, which could confuse screen readers.
